notes: Front calipers read on the car. Passenger/right GM 19141004 (ACDelco 18FR755). Driver/left GM 19141005 (ACDelco 18FR756). Single piston, S10 1983–1997. 19141914 is a rear number and is not these. Not on an invoice.
Spindle castings read on the knuckles. Right 459756, left 459755. G-body / 2WD S10 family. These are knuckles, not calipers. Not on an invoice.

Radiator-to-block hose has to bend. Gates 24024 is a straight stick and is the wrong shape. Buy Vulco-Flex II 25478, 1-1/2 in by 17 in, or the length that matches. O'Reilly: https://www.oreillyauto.com/detail/c/vulco-flex-ii/engine-cooling/radiator-hose/b0a07a12b12d/gates-vulco-flex-ii-coolant-hose/gatc/25478/v/a/15820/automotive-truck-1956-jeep-willys The old end looks about 1 mm over 1-1/2 in. 1-1/2 in is 38 mm. A 33 mm reading is Gates 25253. Not bought yet.

spec.Size: 1-1/2 in inside, 38 mm. Old end looks about 1 mm larger from wear.
spec.33 mm: 33 mm is 1.30 in. That is Gates 25253, the 1-1/4 in flex hose.
spec.Shape: 24024 is a straight stick. This run bends. Do not buy it.
spec.Buy: Vulco-Flex II, 1-1/2 in. 25474 is 12 in, 25476 is 14 in, 25478 is 17 in, 25480 is 20 in, 25482 is 22 in, 25484 is 25 in. Trim the plain cuffs.
spec.Pressure: About 30 psi on the Gates page for this diameter. GM 3.0 manual says not to pressure-test above 20 psi.
